record.title: 以新生成完整对局检验逃生候选覆盖和收益
record.hypothesis: 同一冻结候选在新生成地图上的自然对局中可触发，并可能改善配对得分。
record.scope: 32 new generated terrain clusters; seats and arms paired within cluster. Synthetic distribution only, not independent platform evidence.
record.falsifier: One frozen 128-game batch, 10 sec/job, 1800 sec cap. No tuning or extra seeds after results. No-trigger => defer for insufficient coverage; negative paired mean => investigate regression; production adoption always false.
record.nextStep: 运行128局并保存完整回放；按固定标准评审，不按结果挑场景。

alternatives.name: 新生成地图完整对局
alternatives.benefit: 无需历史后缀，可冻结和复现
alternatives.risk: 模拟器/地图分布不等同平台

criteria.metric: paired map mean score and death
criteria.rule: Screening coverage requires >=8 triggered terrains. Evidence supporting continuation additionally requires mean paired score>=0.1, distribution-free 95% Hoeffding lower bound >0 and death delta<=0. Otherwise no quality success claim. Any integrity/gate failure stops.
Separate future platform and target-runtime validation required
